title: Short Walk to 8 Restaurants + Publix
description:
Welcome to our charming 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath, 2 year old townhome in the historic town of Gallatin, TN. This location is a short walk from a new Publix and 8 restaurants that feature everything you are craving from burgers, smoothies, hibachi, gyro, to Jonathan's Sports Bar. Take a stroll through the charming town square a mile down the road and it's many boutiques, or explore the nearby historic homes, parks, and hiking trails. A quick 35 minute drive will get you to the airport or downtown.

The space
You will enjoy the open concept  floor plan of the first floor complete with a kitchen with a XLARGE island, dining, and living rooms all open to each other. 

No smoking at any time for any reason.

All bedrooms are upstairs with soft and cozy beds to include 1 king, 1 queen, and 2 full sized beds.  2 full sized bathrooms are upstairs with one bathroom in the king bed suite, and 1 full bathroom accessible in the hallway for use by the other guests. There is an additional 1/2 bathroom on the first floor

We also include the following: 
3 New Smart TVs, 50” and larger 
1 gig AT&T fiber WiFi

Luxury down filled sofa
Starter shampoo/conditioner

Bodywash
Makeup face cleaning cloths  
Ample towels 
Extra soft blankets under the Tv downstairs 
Blankets in the closet upstairs 
Washer and Dryer 
Laundry Tabs 
Dryer Sheets
Dedicated workdesk loft area

Guest access
All access to all locations except the owner closet and the laundry room closet

Other things to note
Trash service comes on Thursday mornings so the trash can needs to be outside on Wednesday night. Can will need to be rolled back into the garage once empty
